name: Diseases reported in Africa region
cypher: MATCH (r:Region {name:'Africa'})<-[:IN_REGION]-(c:Country)-[:REPORTED]->(dr:DiseaseReport)-[:REPORT_OF]->(d:Disease) RETURN c.name AS country, d.name AS disease, dr.year AS year, dr.value AS value ORDER BY dr.value DESC LIMIT 100

name: Top-20 countries by yellow fever reports 2019
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:REPORTED]->(dr:DiseaseReport)-[:REPORT_OF]->(d:Disease) WHERE d.name CONTAINS 'yellow fever' AND dr.year = 2019 RETURN c.name AS country, sum(dr.value) AS total ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 20

name: India tuberculosis trend over time
cypher: MATCH (c:Country {name:'India'})-[:REPORTED]->(dr:DiseaseReport)-[:REPORT_OF]->(d:Disease) WHERE d.name CONTAINS 'Tuberculosis' RETURN dr.year AS year, sum(dr.value) AS cases ORDER BY year

name: DTP3 vaccine coverage gaps below 50pct
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:HAS_COVERAGE]->(v:VaccineCoverage) WHERE v.antigen CONTAINS 'DTP3' AND v.year = 2020 AND v.coverage_pct < 50 RETURN c.name AS country, v.antigen AS antigen, v.coverage_pct AS coverage ORDER BY v.coverage_pct ASC LIMIT 50

name: MCV1 coverage by WHO region 2021
cypher: MATCH (r:Region)<-[:IN_REGION]-(c:Country)-[:HAS_COVERAGE]->(v:VaccineCoverage) WHERE v.antigen CONTAINS 'MCV1' AND v.year = 2021 RETURN r.name AS region, avg(v.coverage_pct) AS avg_coverage, count(DISTINCT c) AS countries ORDER BY avg_coverage ASC

name: High PM2.5 cities vs national GNI per capita
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:ENVIRONMENT_OF]->(e:EnvironmentalFactor {indicator_code:'AIR_QUALITY'}), (c)-[:HAS_INDICATOR]->(s:SocioeconomicIndicator {indicator_code:'NY.GNP.PCAP.CD'}) WHERE e.value > 50 AND e.year = s.year RETURN c.name AS country, e.city AS city, e.value AS pm25, s.value AS gni_pc ORDER BY pm25 DESC LIMIT 100

name: Average GNI per capita grouped by income level
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:HAS_INDICATOR]->(s:SocioeconomicIndicator {indicator_code:'NY.GNP.PCAP.CD'}) WHERE c.income_level IS NOT NULL RETURN c.income_level AS income, avg(s.value) AS avg_gni_pc, count(DISTINCT c) AS countries ORDER BY avg_gni_pc DESC

name: Lowest doctor density countries 2020
cypher: MATCH (h:HealthWorkforce)-[:SERVES]->(c:Country) WHERE h.profession = 'physicians' AND h.year = 2020 RETURN c.name AS country, h.density_per_10k AS doctors_per_10k ORDER BY h.density_per_10k ASC LIMIT 25

name: TB burden vs emergency response capacity
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:REPORTED]->(dr:DiseaseReport)-[:REPORT_OF]->(d:Disease) WHERE d.name CONTAINS 'Tuberculosis' WITH c, sum(dr.value) AS tb_burden MATCH (er:EmergencyResponse)-[:CAPACITY_FOR]->(c) RETURN c.name AS country, tb_burden, avg(er.score) AS avg_capacity, count(er) AS capacity_records ORDER BY tb_burden DESC LIMIT 30

name: India surveilled diseases vs clinical trials
cypher: MATCH (c:Country {name:'India'})-[:REPORTED]->(:DiseaseReport)-[:REPORT_OF]->(d:Disease) WITH c, collect(DISTINCT d.name) AS diseases MATCH (ct:ClinicalTrial)-[:CONDUCTED_AT]->(s:Site) WHERE s.country = c.name MATCH (ct)-[:STUDIES]->(cond:Condition) RETURN cond.name AS condition, count(DISTINCT ct) AS trials ORDER BY trials DESC LIMIT 50

name: Economic indicators vs reported cholera burden
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:REPORTED]->(dr:DiseaseReport)-[:REPORT_OF]->(d:Disease) WHERE d.name CONTAINS 'cholera' WITH c, sum(dr.value) AS burden MATCH (c)-[:HAS_INDICATOR]->(s:SocioeconomicIndicator {indicator_code:'NY.GNP.PCAP.CD'}) RETURN c.name AS country, avg(s.value) AS gni_pc, burden ORDER BY burden DESC LIMIT 25

name: HIV clinical trials in African countries
cypher: MATCH (r:Region {name:'Africa'})<-[:IN_REGION]-(c:Country) WITH collect(c.name) AS african MATCH (ct:ClinicalTrial)-[:STUDIES]->(cond:Condition), (ct)-[:CONDUCTED_AT]->(s:Site) WHERE cond.name CONTAINS 'HIV' AND s.country IN african RETURN s.country AS country, count(DISTINCT ct) AS trials ORDER BY trials DESC LIMIT 30

name: TB literature by journal
cypher: MATCH (a:Article)-[:ANNOTATED_WITH]->(m:MeSHTerm) WHERE m.name CONTAINS 'Tuberculosis' MATCH (a)-[:PUBLISHED_IN]->(j:Journal) RETURN j.title AS journal, count(DISTINCT a) AS articles ORDER BY articles DESC LIMIT 25

name: Global disease report totals per disease
cypher: MATCH (dr:DiseaseReport)-[:REPORT_OF]->(d:Disease) RETURN d.name AS disease, count(dr) AS reports, sum(dr.value) AS total ORDER BY total DESC

name: Global disease reports per year
cypher: MATCH (:Country)-[:REPORTED]->(dr:DiseaseReport) RETURN dr.year AS year, count(dr) AS reports ORDER BY year

name: Water stress vs undernutrition per country
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:WATER_RESOURCE_OF]->(w:WaterResource), (c)-[:NUTRITION_STATUS]->(n:NutritionIndicator) WHERE w.year = n.year RETURN c.name AS country, avg(w.value) AS water, avg(n.value) AS nutrition ORDER BY nutrition DESC LIMIT 50

name: Nigeria vaccine coverage trend by antigen
cypher: MATCH (c:Country {name:'Nigeria'})-[:HAS_COVERAGE]->(v:VaccineCoverage) RETURN v.antigen AS antigen, v.year AS year, v.coverage_pct AS coverage ORDER BY v.year, v.antigen LIMIT 200

name: African TB federated profile across Surveillance HealthSystems and Determinants
cypher: MATCH (r:Region {name:'Africa'})<-[:IN_REGION]-(c:Country)-[:REPORTED]->(dr:DiseaseReport)-[:REPORT_OF]->(d:Disease) WHERE d.name CONTAINS 'Tuberculosis' WITH c, sum(dr.value) AS tb_burden OPTIONAL MATCH (hw:HealthWorkforce {profession:'physicians'})-[:SERVES]->(c) WITH c, tb_burden, avg(hw.density_per_10k) AS doc_density OPTIONAL MATCH (er:EmergencyResponse)-[:CAPACITY_FOR]->(c) WITH c, tb_burden, doc_density, avg(er.score) AS ihr_score OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[:HAS_INDICATOR]->(s:SocioeconomicIndicator {indicator_code:'NY.GNP.PCAP.CD'}) RETURN c.name AS country, tb_burden, doc_density, ihr_score, avg(s.value) AS gni_pc ORDER BY tb_burden DESC LIMIT 50
